legs.falsify: verify.py independent original Git/source reconstruction, separate finite source boundary oracle, fresh public/compiler results and genuine node/source/line/scope/result controls.
legs.rederive: derive.py complete fixed original statements and literal expression spans; candidates precede public measurements.

original_recipes.role: Finite complete own-source statement alternatives; ordered refusal binding and original coordinate selections remain successor-owned.

statements.text: _require($kind ne 'bit' || $spec->{width} == 1, 'bit type width must be one');

_require(ref($members) eq 'HASH' && ref($order) eq 'ARRAY' && scalar(@$order),
            'record requires ordered members');
_require($spec->{signed} == 0, "$context aggregate has a scalar signed overlay");

_require(_positive($value->{width}) && $value->{width} == $value->{type_spec}{width},
        "$context value width disagrees with resolved type");

_require($access ne 'write' || $root->{role} ne 'input',
        "$context cannot write declared input '$token'");

_require($allow_whole || !_aggregate($spec),
            "$context requires a scalar value; '$token' is a whole $spec->{kind}");

_require(!_aggregate($resolved->{type_spec}),
        "$context requires a scalar leaf; '$token' resolves to $resolved->{type_spec}{kind}");

_require(_whole_record($source) && _whole_record($target),
        "$context whole record port copy requires declared record roots");
_keys($value, [qw(root role path_text type_spec width)], [qw(low high)], "$context value");
confess "Invalid ISF interface port metadata: $_[1]\n" unless $_[0];
like($diagnostic, $pattern, "$name names the cause in its diagnostic line");

return record_value_reference(scope => $scope, token => $token,
        access => $access || 'read', allow_whole => $whole || 0, context => 'control');

return validate_record_port_copy(source => reference($scope, $source, 'read', 1),
        target => reference($scope, $target, 'write', 1), context => 'copy control');

source_phases.role: Ordered own-source refusal-phase statement hypotheses; original coordinates, private runtime meanings and alias downstream remain unmeasured.

statements.text: _require($spec->{signed} == 0, "$context aggregate has a scalar signed overlay");

_require(_positive($value->{width}) && $value->{width} == $value->{type_spec}{width},
        "$context value width disagrees with resolved type");

_require($access ne 'write' || $root->{role} ne 'input',
        "$context cannot write declared input '$token'");

_require($allow_whole || !_aggregate($spec),
            "$context requires a scalar value; '$token' is a whole $spec->{kind}");

_require(!_aggregate($resolved->{type_spec}),
        "$context requires a scalar leaf; '$token' resolves to $resolved->{type_spec}{kind}");

_require(_whole_record($source) && _whole_record($target),
        "$context whole record port copy requires declared record roots");
